claims.text: On 2026-11-19 the developer banteg posted that Gemini 4 Neon "takes 4th place" in his Sokoban eval
The public site states one scored attempt per model, medium reasoning effort, and a budget per part of 5 hours of active time, 1,000 turns and 10,000 keys.
With a Python notebook the order changed in ways that matter for tool-use comparisons
the first-race write-up states that cost is measured in time, turns and keys, with no dollar accounting.
Its direct standard price is $1.50 input and $7.50 output per million tokens, with cached input at $0.075.
Hydrogen at high effort scores 51 at $1.87 per task, Terra also scores 51 at $0.96 per task
Independent trackers put Neon at 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh, with $6.44 per index task
Google reports Neon at 32% lower cost per task than Carbon at default high thinking.
